literal: Other attachment what indeed, birth severing to those who have undertaken, even the body is excess.
translation: To those who have undertaken the severing of births, even their own body is a burden. What then is the purpose of other attachments?
modern: பிறப்பை அறுக்க முயல்பவர்களுக்குத் தம் உடம்பே ஒரு சுமையாகும். அப்படியிருக்க, அவர்களுக்கு வேறு பற்றுதல்களால் என்ன பயன்?
explanation: This couplet questions the logic of holding onto worldly attachments when the ultimate goal is renunciation. For those who have committed to ending the cycle of birth, even their own physical body is considered an excess. The word 'mikai' can mean excess, fault, or burden, and here it best means an unnecessary excess or burden. If the body itself is more than what is necessary, any other external connection or possession is entirely pointless.
